episodes.title: The death of the man who conned me | Autopsy of a cult-like relationship
episodes.description:
Long ago, I never would have considered myself vulnerable to falling into a cult-like relationship with a “spiritual teacher.“ But then I did. And decades later, when I finally woke up in horror to the harm ￼this was causing for virtually everyone I knew￼, all I could do was face the consequences. I recently learned that the man I followed had died. This is an autopsy of that twisted relationship.

There is a psychological profile for people who are considered vulnerable to cults. I didn’t fit it. I was a successful performer, beloved in my community, living on a beautiful country road with a woman I loved and would eventually marry. Many would have considered it a good life, even an idyllic one.
But as good as things appeared to be, I always knew there was something missing, something deeper to live and express. ￼ When ￼ my wife found a spiritual teacher and healer in Connecticut who helped her with a debilitating illness, I took appointments with him as well, drawn ￼to his promises of deeply aligning our lives with the “God within us.” Initially, I trusted him, so much so that I did not notice (or ignored) the lies and the manipulation that followed slowly and gradually after the glorious hook.
This is the story of how this not only CAN happen, but how it actually DID happen to me…

#awakening #innerwork #integrity #memoir #cult
